extra.message: User input from the 'username' parameter is concatenated directly into the template string passed to Jinja2's from_string() before rendering. This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) which can lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Coupling of Template Engine with Template Structure
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
